concept.title: AuditX Product Overview
concept.shortdesc: AuditX is a comprehensive order verification and visual documentation platform designed for eCommerce and logistics operations. It enables real-time capture, verification, and linkage of packing activities to order IDs for complete traceability.

section.title: Product Purpose
section.p: AuditX provides a unified solution for capturing and verifying packed items against original order data. It integrates with major eCommerce platforms like Shopify to ensure accuracy before shipping, reducing mis-shipments and enabling quick resolution of disputes.

ul.li: Order Verification Workflow: Automatically record and validate packed items against Shopify or other eCommerce orders to ensure accuracy before shipping.
Video Recording Workflow: Record the entire packing process and link the video to the order ID for complete visual proof during audits and dispute resolution.
Image Logging Workflow: Capture high-resolution images of packed orders or key packing steps, linking them directly to order IDs for quick verification.
Multi-Channel Integration: Seamless webhook integration with Shopify, WMS systems, and custom external applications.
Comprehensive Reporting: Access complete event logs with barcode tracking, video playback, sub-event images, and export capabilities.
